description: Brave Search. Search Brave Search via API and retrieve structured organic results with pagination. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

gl.description: Country code, for example us, fr, gb, de. Default: "us".

hl.description: Language code, for example en, fr, de. Default: "en".

query.description: The search query you want to run on Brave Search.

name: brave_search
title: Brave Search
